text:
anya: Quick sync — BigCorp requested a tenant-level A/B for the reranking model. They want opt-in at tenant level plus a rapid rollback. Proposed flow: shadow -> micro-canary (synthetic probes + 5 tenants) -> phased regional ramp with auto-fallback to stable. Thoughts?

sam: +1. Put it behind ff.tenant_rerank_v2. Micro-canary: 1% traffic for 48h across 5 tenants, hourly synthetic probes, metric checks every 15m.

lee: Ops items: define health gates. Rollback triggers: p95 latency > 300ms for 15m OR error rate > 1% for 5m. Add cost guard: if cost/request delta > 7% for 1h -> pause ramp. Don't ramp APAC and NA simultaneously.

carlos: From customer POV need success metrics: BigCorp expects ~2% lift on rerank CTR top-3, zero latency regressions. Cost impact target <5%. Can we pipe experiment metrics into their NRPS dashboard?

anya: Launch checklist: 1) telemetry emits experiment_id + tenant + route 2) SLO gates (lee's) 3) quality: A/B >=1.5% lift with p<0.05 at 48h OR consistent direction at 72h 4) cost delta <5% at 72h 5) runbook + rollback tested. Gate fail -> auto-fallback to model-rerank-stable.

sam: Router will honor X-Experiment-Id header and tenant override. Two infra tasks: (A) tenant override in FF UI/API, (B) routing rule to pin model by experiment_id. I'll own both.

lee: Add runbook snippets and test in staging. Example kill switch:
```bash
# turn off tenant flag for BigCorp
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MGMT' https://flags.redwood.internal/api/flags/ff.tenant_rerank_v2/override -d '{"tenant":"bigcorp","enabled":false}'
```
Router override: 
```bash
# force stable model for tenant
POST https://router.redwood.internal/route/override -d '{"match":"tenant:bigcorp","model":"model-rerank-stable"}'
```
Smoke-test these today.

deploy-bot: deploy:release/feat/tenant-ab started by @sam (1770013480) :rocket:

carlos: Experiments: do both within-tenant A/B (user 50/50) and tenant-level opt-in. BigCorp prefers tenant opt-in first. We'll run user-level A/B during micro-canary for validation.

anya: Timeline: week0 = config + infra + runbook; week1 = shadow + synthetic probes; week2 = micro-canary (5 tenants incl. BigCorp); week3 = phased regional ramp NA -> EU -> APAC with step increases if gates pass.

sam: Need BigCorp prompt set for probes and expected labels. Also add sidecar evaluator returning top-K delta per probe for quick lift calc.

carlos: I'll provide the prompt set and check contract/legal re: metrics sharing.

lee: SRE checklist: add alerts experiment_p95_latency, experiment_error_rate, experiment_quality_delta, experiment_cost_delta. Tag dashboards with experiment id. Pre-create incident stub.

anya: Owners: sam = infra & rollout impl, lee = SRE gates & runbook, carlos = customer artifacts & success criteria, anya = PM owner. Scheduling 30m post-PR sync.

sam: Opening PR today; flag schema at configs/flags/ff.tenant_rerank_v2.json.

deploy-bot: deploy:release/feat/tenant-ab succeeded (1770013555) :white_check_mark:

anya: Great. After PR lands we'll smoke in staging and follow timeline. Speak up if there are hidden risks. :thumbsup:
